_meta.source: 16-agent point-in-time audit: input availability timing traced in both OSAP scripts and engine trees
_meta.principle: no information may be used before its public availability month

factors.input_timing: at: from m_aCompustat, stamped time_avail_m = datadate + 6 months (CompustatAnnual.py:212-215), i.e. public well before use. mve_permco: monthlyCRSP end-of-month t market equity, available at end of month t. Script AM.py merges both at the same time_avail_m; engine expression div(at, mve_permco) aligns the same panels at t.
factors.mechanism: Both sides combine a >=6-month-lagged accounting level with end-of-month-t market equity at stamp t; no forward-dated field is touched.

factors.input_timing: feps1/feps2: IBES fpi=1/2 mean estimates with statpers in May (public mid-May), shifted +1 month and used at June stamps (script lines 50-79, engine p1_factor_engine.py:1345-1356). LTG: fpi=0 statpers-June summary (public mid-June) used at June. prc/shrout: end-of-June CRSP. ceq/ibcom/sale/dvc/at: m_aCompustat at June with 6-month lag, and the screen datadate.month>=6 forces fiscal year-ends Jun-Dec of the prior year. sale t-60 lag is backward. June value held forward 0..11 months.
factors.mechanism: AOP = (AnalystValue - IntrinsicValue)/|IntrinsicValue| built entirely from May forecasts, mid-June LTG, end-of-June prices, and >=6-month-lagged fundamentals; the 12-month expansion only pushes values FORWARD in time. Identical logic in ZZ1 script and _prepare_analyst_value_signals.

factors.input_timing: Fundamentals (act, che, lct, dlc, at, ib, sale, ppegt, oancf/fopt, ni, sic) from a_aCompustat stamped time_avail_m = datadate + 6 months. A Compustat fyear y pools datadates from Jun-y through May-(y+1), so stamps within one fyear group span Dec-y through Nov-(y+1). The residual for the earliest-stamped firm (Dec-y) is computed from a regression whose inputs include peers whose fundamentals only become available up to Nov-(y+1) — up to 11 months after the stamp.
factors.mechanism: BOTH sides leak. Script ZZ2_AbnormalAccruals_AbnormalAccrualsPercent.py: winsor2 trim by=['fyear'] (line 138) and OLS residuals .over(['fyear','sic2']) (lines 151-163) pool the full fiscal-year cross-section, so a firm's residual stamped at its own datadate+6 depends on regression coefficients and trim cutoffs estimated from peers' statements published up to ~11 months later. Engine p1_factor_engine.py: _trim_by_group(..., 'fyear', 0.001, 0.999) (line 1690) and _ols_residuals_by_groups(group_cols=['fyear','sic2']) (lines 1692-1698) reproduce the same contemporaneous-fyear pooling, then _expand_hold_months holds the contaminated value 12 more months. (This mirrors Xie 2001's in-sample cross-sectional estimation, but it is a genuine availability violation at the stamped month.)

factors.input_timing: act, che, lct, dlc, txp, at, dp all from m_aCompustat at t (datadate + 6-month lag) and their 12-month-lagged panel values (shift(12) on a gap-free monthly panel in both script Accruals.py:77-99 and engine delta/lag ops on the full month-start template index, p1_factor_engine.py:671,704-714).
factors.mechanism: Only current-stamp (already 6-month-lagged) and t-12 values enter; shifts are strictly backward. Non-timing note: the engine expression omits the script's '- dp' (depreciation) term in the numerator — a fidelity discrepancy vs Sloan/OSAP, but no look-ahead.

factors.input_timing: ceq, act, che, lct, dlc, txp, at from m_aCompustat at t (datadate + 6-month lag) plus t-12 lags; mve_permco end-of-month t. Quintile ranks (fastxtile by time_avail_m in script; _row_bucket per-row in engine, p1_factor_engine.py:938-942,1057-1063) are same-month cross-sections.
factors.mechanism: The binary signal compares month-t cross-sectional ranks of quantities that are all publicly available by end of t; ranking within the same month uses no forward information.

factors.input_timing: xad: m_aCompustat at t (datadate + 6-month lag). mve_permco: end-of-month t. Script AdExp.py and engine positive_only(div(xad, mve_permco)) are contemporaneous merges at t.
factors.mechanism: Single lagged accounting field over current market equity; the positivity screen is applied on the same-stamp value only.

factors.input_timing: meanest: IBES summary stamped by statpers month (statpers falls mid-month, so the month-t value is public before end of t; IBESEPSUnadjusted.py:47-67 keeps the latest statpers per ticker-fpi-month). Signal = meanest(t)/meanest(t-1) via shift(1) in the script and lag(...,1) on the full monthly template in the engine.
factors.mechanism: Ratio of the month-t summary forecast to the month-(t-1) summary forecast — both issued on or before their stamp months. Non-timing note: the engine's var loader (p1_factor_engine.py:416-431) does not filter fpi, and pivot aggfunc='last' on the fpi-sorted raw file effectively picks the fpi='6' (current-quarter) row rather than the script's fpi='1' FY1 forecast — a fidelity bug, not a leak, since all fpi rows share the same statpers stamp.

factors.input_timing: Same inputs as AOP: May-statpers FY1/FY2 forecasts used at June (+1-month conservative shift), mid-June LTG at June, end-of-June prc/shrout, m_aCompustat fundamentals at June with 6-month lag and datadate-month>=6 screen, sale t-60. June value expanded forward 12 months (script ZZ1 lines 449-461; engine _prepare_analyst_value_signals lines 1450-1456).
factors.mechanism: Three-stage residual-income valuation from forecasts issued before or during the stamp month and lagged fundamentals; the annual-to-monthly expansion only carries values into later months.

factors.input_timing: Engine runs the script (_can_execute_natively('AnnouncementReturn') = False; the announcement_return op has no native implementation), so only ZZ2_AnnouncementReturn.py matters. rdq: actual earnings announcement date from m_QCompustat. dailyCRSP ret and dailyFF mktrf/rf: available same day. CAR window is [ann-2, ann+1] business days; the value is stamped at the month of the window's LAST day (agg time_d 'max', line 121-128), then forward-filled up to 6 months.
factors.mechanism: Stamping at the month containing ann+1 guarantees every return in the window is realized by end of the stamp month (a month-end announcement whose +1 day spills into t+1 gets stamped at t+1); the 6-month fill only propagates past values forward. CCM link rows are restricted to their validity window.

factors.input_timing: at: m_aCompustat at t (datadate + 6-month lag) and its 12-month lag (shift(12) within permno in the script; lag(at,12) on the gap-free month-start template in the engine).
factors.mechanism: (at_t - at_{t-12})/at_{t-12} with both operands at or before the stamp; strictly backward shifts on both sides.

factors.input_timing: ceqt: m_aCompustat at t (datadate + 6-month lag). Market equity: script BM.py takes mve_permco from the month 6 stamps back only when that month equals the datadate month, then forward-fills (lines 51-62) — i.e. ME frozen at the fiscal-year-end month, always in the past; engine op market_equity_matched_to_datadate is simply lag(mve_permco, 6) (p1_factor_engine.py:762-766).
factors.mechanism: Both denominators are market equity from >=6 months before the stamp (script: exact datadate-month ME held forward; engine: rolling t-6 ME). All inputs strictly historical; the engine's rolling approximation differs in vintage but never reaches past month t.

factors.input_timing: Book equity (seq/ceq+PS/at-lt + txditc - PS): m_aCompustat at t (datadate + 6-month lag). December ME: computed from end-of-December prc*shrout and assigned to all months of that calendar year (script tempDecME transform, lines 78-82; engine groupby(year).transform('min'), lines 2028-2029) — which nominally places Dec-y ME on Jan-Nov-y rows — but it is only ever READ through 12-month (months>=6) or 17-month (months<6) lags (script lines 113-162; engine shift(12)/shift(17), lines 2037-2039).
factors.mechanism: Although Dec ME is stored on pre-December rows, every access path lags >=12 months, so a stamp in Jun-Dec of year y uses Dec-(y-1) ME and a stamp in Jan-May uses Dec-(y-2) ME — both from completed Decembers well before the stamp month. Book equity carries the standard 6-month reporting lag. No forward access on either side.

factors.input_timing: che/dltt/dlc/dc/dvpa/tstkp/ceq from m_aCompustat at t (public since datadate+6, datadate<=t-6); mve_permco from SignalMasterTable/monthlyCRSP at t (end-of-month t market cap, public at end of t). Engine (native) uses identical tree with monthlyCRSP mve_permco.
factors.mechanism: All accounting inputs carry the embedded 6-month reporting lag and market equity is used contemporaneously at month-end t; no lags cross forward on either side (script ZZ1_EBM_BPEBM.py joins on same time_avail_m; engine aligns panels on each dataset's own time_avail_m).

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret at months t-59..t (each public at its own month-end); monthlyFF rf and monthlyMarket ewretd at the same months. Value stamped at t uses window ending at t.
factors.mechanism: polars-ols rolling_ols is a trailing 60-obs window ending at the stamped row (Beta.py lines 93-105); month-t return is realized by end of month t. Engine side is script-backed (rolling_beta is a delegated operator), so engine timing = script timing. Note: the unexecuted spec tree uses vwretd vs the script's ewretd — a formula mismatch, not a timing leak.

factors.input_timing: dailyCRSP ret and dailyFF rf/mktrf at daily dates up to the last trading day of month t; 252-day vol and 1260-day R2 windows are trailing; monthly value = last daily BetaFP within month t, stamped at t.
factors.mechanism: All rolling_std/rolling_mean and shift(1)/shift(2) constructions in ZZ2_BetaFP.py are backward-looking, and the month-t stamp aggregates only daily observations dated inside month t (lines 147-158). Engine is script-backed, so identical.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret and monthlyFF rf/mktrf/hml/smb at months t-59..t (public at their own month-ends); ps_innov from WRDS ff.liq_ps at the same months — but the ps_innov value for month tau is constructed by Pastor-Stambaugh from a liquidity-innovation regression whose coefficients are estimated on the full published sample, and the series is only released/extended periodically, so the number used for month tau was not publicly observable at end of month tau.
factors.mechanism: Leak is in the input series, identical on both sides (engine is script-backed): LiquidityFactor.py stamps ff.liq_ps rows at their own month with no real-time vintage, and BetaLiquidityPS.py's trailing 60-month regression (lines 86-99, itself correctly backward-looking) consumes ps_innov values whose construction embeds full-sample (post-tau) information. This is the standard series used in the literature, but under a strict point-in-time criterion historical ps_innov values are revised ex post. Script's own alignment logic contains no other leak. Side note: the unexecuted engine spec declares window 36/min 12 vs the script's 60/36 — a parameter mismatch, not a leak.

factors.input_timing: Tail factor for month tau built from dailyCRSP returns dated within tau (cross-sectional 5th percentile and tail exceedances, BetaTailRisk.py lines 43-81) — fully known at end of tau; monthlyCRSP ret at months t-119..t; beta stamped at t from trailing 120-month window.
factors.mechanism: The monthly tail-risk factor uses only same-month daily data and the rolling_ols window is trailing (lines 127-137); shrcd filter uses month-t CRSP names data. Engine is script-backed, so identical.

factors.input_timing: at/lt/txditc/pstk/pstkrv/pstkl/seq/ceq all from m_aCompustat at t (public since datadate+6). Engine (native) uses only at and ceq from the same panel at t.
factors.mechanism: Single-date accounting ratio with the 6-month availability lag baked into m_aCompustat; no lags, no market data, no self-joins on either side. (Engine formula log(at/ceq) omits the script's seq/txditc/preferred-stock fallbacks — a fidelity gap, not a timing leak.)

factors.input_timing: xad/xad0/at/sic from a_aCompustat by fiscal year (each row public at datadate+6); BrandCapital recursion for FY Y uses xad of FY<=Y; BrandInvest = xad0(FY Y)/BrandCapital(FY Y-1); December-FYE rows expanded to months datadate+6 .. datadate+17.
factors.mechanism: Both script (BrandInvest.py lines 97-126, 149-165) and native engine op (_op_brand_invest_signal, p1_factor_engine.py lines 1548-1600) use shift(1)/prior-row recursion over fiscal years sorted ascending, and the keep-last-datadate dedup after monthly expansion only ever selects a datadate that is >=6 months before the stamped month — a newer fiscal year replaces an older one exactly when its own datadate+6 arrives.

factors.input_timing: revt/cogs/xsga/xrd and working-capital items from m_aCompustat at t (public since datadate+6) and their calendar 12-month lags at t-12 (public since t-12); mve_permco/mve_c and ceq for the BM exclusion filter at t (month-end t); sicCRSP/shrcd at t.
factors.mechanism: The l12 self-join in CBOperProf.py (lines 95-105) merges lag_time = t-12 months onto t, i.e. aligns t with t-12 (past), never t+k; exclusion filters use only end-of-month-t information. Engine-native tree uses only same-month revt/cogs/xsga/at/sic (no accrual-change terms — formula fidelity gap vs the script, but no future data).

factors.input_timing: ib and dp from m_aCompustat at t (public since datadate+6); mve_permco at t (end-of-month t). Engine native tree identical (monthlyCRSP mve_permco).
factors.mechanism: Contemporaneous join of 6-month-lagged annual accounting data with month-end market equity on both sides; no lag or dedup pattern that could pick future rows.

factors.input_timing: cheq/atq from m_QCompustat. Script (Cash.py) re-stamps availability at the rdq month and carries it 3 months, keeping the newest rdq<=t per month — the announcement date rdq falls inside the stamped month t, so the data is public by end of month t (the audit's availability standard). Engine (native) uses m_QCompustat's own time_avail_m = max(datadate+3mo, rdq month), with >6-month-late filings dropped — same or more conservative.
factors.mechanism: Both sides stamp at or after the announcement month and the keep-newest-rdq dedup only selects announcements dated <=t. Caveat, not a leak under the stated convention: because the stamp is the rdq month (announcement can be mid/late month), the value is only safe for portfolios formed at month-end t or later — consistent with the repo's t -> t+1 usage; it would leak only if consumed intramonth before rdq day.

factors.input_timing: at and che from m_aCompustat at t (public since datadate+6); mve_permco at t (end-of-month t). Engine native tree identical.
factors.mechanism: Contemporaneous same-month join of lagged accounting data and month-end market cap on both sides; no lags or self-joins.

factors.input_timing: rect/invt/aco/ppent/intan/ap/lco/lo/sale from m_aCompustat at t (FY Y, public since datadate+6) and at t-12 (FY Y-1) via calendar-based lag; ChAssetTurnover = ATO(t) - ATO(t-12).
factors.mechanism: Script (ChAssetTurnover.py lines 65-91) builds lags by merging lag_time = t-12 onto t (past-only), and ppent ffill propagates only prior months forward; engine uses lag(...,12)/delta(...,12) implemented as shift(12) on a continuous month-start index (p1_factor_engine.py lines 704-714, 671), which is strictly backward. Verified the const args are n=12 on both lag and delta nodes.

factors.input_timing: ceq from m_aCompustat: public ~datadate+6mo (annual report lag), stamped time_avail_m=datadate+6 and used at t and t-12. Script lag is positional shift(12) over unique permno-month rows (>=12 calendar months back); engine lag is calendar shift(12) on a contiguous monthly panel.
factors.mechanism: Clean: both sides use only 6-month-lagged annual data at t and a >=12-month lag; positional shift on unique-month rows can only reach further back, never forward. (Non-timing note: engine computes ceq/l12-1 without the script's ceq>0 & l12>0 filter — fidelity, not lookahead.)

factors.input_timing: meanest (IBES fpi=1 summary): computed at statpers (mid-month t), public before end of t, stamped month(statpers); prior estimate via shift(1) reaches the previous available month <= t-1. Accrual inputs (act,che,lct,dlc,txp,at) from m_aCompustat: public datadate+6, used at t vs exact calendar t-12 (script create_calendar_lag; engine _op_chforecast_accrual_signal lines 2386-2422 uses shift(12) over unique permno-month rows).
factors.mechanism: Clean: forecast revision compares month t summary to an earlier month's summary; the accrual median split (groupby time_avail_m qcut) is a same-month cross-section of values all public by end of t. No future-stamped input on either side.

factors.input_timing: invt, at from m_aCompustat: public datadate+6mo, stamped accordingly; used at t and t-12 (script positional shift(12) over unique monthly rows; engine calendar delta/lag 12 on contiguous panel).
factors.mechanism: Clean: pure 12-month change in 6-month-lagged annual data; lags can only fetch equal-or-older vintages (dedup in CompustatAnnual.py keeps latest datadate whose availability start is still <= t).

factors.input_timing: capx, ppent, at from m_aCompustat: public datadate+6mo, used at t, t-12, t-24 via exact calendar-merge lags (script) / calendar shifts (engine). sicCRSP: CRSP name-history industry code for month t (msenames namedt<=date<=nameendt join in CRSPMonthly.py), contemporaneous. Industry mean: cross-section within (2-digit SIC, month t).
factors.mechanism: Clean: firm-level growth uses only lagged fundamentals; industry demeaning (script groupby transform mean; engine _op_industry_adjusted_mean line 887) averages only month-t values that are each public by end of t; SIC assignment is the code valid during month t, not a future reclassification.

factors.input_timing: numest (IBES fpi=1 summary): statpers mid-month t, public before month-end, stamped month(statpers); compared to exact calendar t-3 via stata_multi_lag with gap-filling (script) / lag-1 calendar shift (engine). mve_c: CRSP market equity at end of month t, used for the same-month size-quintile screen.
factors.mechanism: Clean: coverage change uses t vs t-3 (script) or t vs t-1 (engine), both backward; size screen is contemporaneous end-of-month ME. Two non-lookahead caveats: (1) the Jul-Sep 1987 exclusion (script lines 85-88) is an ex-post data-quality sample filter from the original paper, not an information leak; (2) engine-side the numest var loads through DatasetStore's LINKED path (engine lines 416-431) with NO fpi filter — pivot aggfunc='last' mixes fpi 0/1/2/6 rows of the same month (horizon-mixing fidelity bug, all same-month-stamped, no future info).

factors.input_timing: at, act, ivao, lt, dlc, dltt from m_aCompustat: public datadate+6mo; NNCOA ratio computed at t and t-12 (script positional shift(12) over unique monthly rows; engine calendar delta 12).
factors.mechanism: Clean: 12-month first difference of a ratio built entirely from 6-month-lagged annual data; no contemporaneous-datadate or future-vintage access on either side.

factors.input_timing: act, che, lct, dlc, at from m_aCompustat: public datadate+6mo; NWC/at at t minus exact calendar t-12 (script stata_multi_lag with fill_date_gaps guarantees true 12-calendar-month lag; engine calendar delta 12 on contiguous panel).
factors.mechanism: Clean: identical availability-stamped inputs on both sides, backward-only calendar lags.

factors.input_timing: txtq from m_QCompustat: stamped max(datadate+3mo, month(rdq)) with >6mo-late filings dropped (CompustatQuarterly.py:88-113), so a quarter announced on any day of month t is first usable at end of t — correct for end-of-month formation predicting t+1; used at t vs exact calendar t-12. Denominator: script uses annual at from m_aCompustat at t-12 (public datadate+6); engine uses quarterly atq at t-12 (same rdq-aware stamp).
factors.mechanism: Clean: rdq-month stamping makes announcement-month data available only at that month's end, never before the announcement; missing-rdq rows fall back to the standard datadate+3 assumption and cannot be later than actual rdq by more than the dropped >6mo tail. Lag-12 denominators are strictly older vintages. (Engine's atq-vs-annual-at swap is a methodology difference, not timing.)

factors.input_timing: ireccd from IBES recddet: public at anndats, stamped month(anndats); collapsed to analyst-month last rec then firm-month mean, all within month t; change = month-t mean minus previous observed month's mean (groupby shift/diff, positional so the base month is <= t-1). Permno link: month-t valid IBES-CRSP link window.
factors.mechanism: Clean: both script (shift(1) on ticker-sorted monthly means) and engine (_op_change_in_recommendation_signal line 2331, groupby diff) difference month t against an earlier observed month only. Minor non-timing note: script's first collapse (line 31-35) calls .last() without sorting by anndats, so within-month analyst dedup may pick a non-latest same-month rec — still month-t information.

factors.input_timing: ret and mve_c/mve_permco from monthlyCRSP: month-t return and end-of-month-t market equity, both known at month-end t; compared to exact calendar t-60 (script stata_multi_lag with gap fill; engine lag-60 calendar shift). Script BH return = cumulative return index t vs t-60 (includes month-t return, available end of t); engine compound_return over lags 1..60 (returns t-60..t-1).
factors.mechanism: Clean: 5-year growth of ME minus 5-year buy-and-hold return uses only end-of-month-t and older prices/returns. Non-lookahead fidelity bugs on the engine side: the compounding window (t-60..t-1) is shifted one month early relative to the ME window (t-59..t) and misses month-t return, missing returns are filled with 0 across the whole template, and mve_permco replaces the script's mve_c — all backward-looking discrepancies, no future data.

factors.input_timing: dltt, dlc from m_aCompustat: public datadate+6mo; script uses (dltt+dlc) at t vs exact calendar t-60 (positional shift(60) fallback reaches >=60 months back); engine uses dltt at t, t-12, t-60 via calendar shifts.
factors.mechanism: Clean: all inputs are 6-month-lagged annual vintages at t or strictly earlier. Non-timing note: engine tree log(dltt/l60)-log(dltt/l12) collapses to log(dltt_{t-12}/dltt_{t-60}) and drops dlc — a fidelity divergence from Lyandres-Sun-Zhang, but built entirely from lags.

factors.input_timing: ireccd from IBES recddet: public at anndats, stamped month(anndats); firm-month mean over analysts' latest month-t recs, thresholded (>3 -> 1, <=1.5 -> 0); permno via month-t valid link window. No lags used.
factors.mechanism: Clean: level signal built solely from recommendations announced during month t, stamped to that month, on both script and engine (_op_binary_recommendation_level line 2050 replicates the script including the anndats within-month sort).

factors.input_timing: dc, cshrc from m_aCompustat: fiscal-year values at datadate, public at filing (~3-4mo after FYE); stamped at time_avail_m = datadate+6mo (CompustatAnnual.py:212-215), used at that month or later via 12-month forward expansion with dedup keeping the latest datadate whose +6mo has already passed.
factors.mechanism: Pure contemporaneous indicator on 6-month-lagged annual data; engine (native) uses the same lagged panel via _op_convertible_debt_indicator (p1_factor_engine.py:815). Engine ignores cshrc and negative dc vs the script's dc!=0|cshrc!=0 — a fidelity gap, not a timing leak.

factors.input_timing: dailyCRSP ret and dailyFF mktrf/rf at day d: public end of day d; the value stamped at time_avail_m=t aggregates daily returns from the day after the prior year's month-t anchor through the last trading day of month t.
factors.mechanism: The descending sort + forward_fill (CoskewACX.py:73,100-107) assigns each day to the NEXT month-m anchor at-or-after it, i.e. a strictly trailing ~12-month window ending at month-t end; the max_nobs completeness filter (lines 163-168) uses only same-period cross-sectional counts. Engine side is script-backed (_can_execute_natively=False), so it inherits the same timing.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret and monthlyFF mktrf/rf for month s: public at end of month s; the value stamped at t uses months (prior 60-cycle anchor, t], i.e. up to 60 months ending at t.
factors.mechanism: Same descending forward_fill construction (Coskewness.py:60,87-107) yields a trailing <=60-month window ending at the stamped month; nobs>=12 filter is within-window. Engine side is script-backed, identical code path.

factors.input_timing: dltis, ceq from m_aCompustat: datadate+6mo availability stamp; mve_permco and shrcd from SignalMasterTable at month t = end-of-month-t prc*shrout from CRSPMonthly (CRSPMonthly.py:73,103), public at month-t close.
factors.mechanism: Indicator dltis>0 on lagged accounting data; the BM=log(ceq/mve) term only gates sample membership using month-t-end market cap, which is available by end of t. Engine (native) is positive_indicator(dltis) on the same lagged panel (p1_factor_engine.py:799) — it drops the BM/shrcd filter (fidelity gap only).

factors.input_timing: act, che, at from m_aCompustat: current row available at datadate+6mo; lagged row taken 12 panel rows earlier (script, DelCOA.py:51-53) or 12 calendar months earlier (engine lag/delta via .shift(12) on a gap-free monthly template index, p1_factor_engine.py:670-671,704-714).
factors.mechanism: Both sides only reach backward: positional shift(12) on an ascending-sorted deduped panel can never fetch a later row (across listing gaps it fetches >12-month-old data — stale, not future), and the engine's calendar shift is exact. All numerator/denominator fields sit on the same already-lagged rows.

factors.input_timing: lct, dlc, at from m_aCompustat at datadate+6mo; 12-month lag via positional shift (script, DelCOL.py:64-66) / calendar shift on complete template index (engine).
factors.mechanism: Identical structure to DelCOA: backward-only lags on 6-month-lagged annual rows; dedup keep='first' and engine pivot aggfunc='last' select among rows all stamped available by month t.

factors.input_timing: drc, at plus filter fields ceq, sale, sic from m_aCompustat, all from the same fiscal-year row available at datadate+6mo; 12-month backward lag for drc and at (script DelDRC.py:70-71; engine delta/lag shift(12)).
factors.mechanism: Change uses only current-row and 12-months-prior data; exclusion filters (ceq<=0, sale<5, SIC 6000-6999) use contemporaneous same-row values, not future ones. Engine (native) omits those filters entirely — fidelity gap, not a leak.

factors.input_timing: ceq, at from m_aCompustat at datadate+6mo; lag obtained by calendar self-join of row t onto row t-12 (DelEqu.py:35-42: time_lag12 = time_avail_m - 12mo, merged so l12_* come from the strictly earlier month).
factors.mechanism: The self-join aligns t with t-12 (current row pulls values FROM 12 months earlier, never the reverse); engine delta/lag(12) is the same backward calendar shift. No alignment of t with t+k on either side.

factors.input_timing: dltt, dlc, pstk, at from m_aCompustat at datadate+6mo; backward calendar self-join to t-12 (DelFINL.py:35-52); engine identical via delta/lag(12) with fillna(0) on pstk.
factors.mechanism: Backward-only t-12 self-join on already-lagged annual data; pstk fillna(0) is a same-row transformation with no timing content.

factors.input_timing: ivao, at from m_aCompustat at datadate+6mo; backward calendar self-join to t-12 (DelLTI.py:35-42); engine delta/lag(12) on the lagged panel.
factors.mechanism: Same backward t-12 join pattern; both sides use only rows whose datadate+6mo stamp is <= t.

factors.input_timing: ivst, ivao, dltt, dlc, pstk, at from m_aCompustat at datadate+6mo; net-financial-assets composite built on the current row, then backward calendar self-join to t-12 (DelNetFin.py:45-58); engine delta/lag(12) equivalent.
factors.mechanism: Composite and its lag are both computed from rows available at their own stamped months; join direction is strictly t pulling from t-12.

factors.input_timing: CRSPdistributions divamt/cd2 stamped at exdt month (script DivInit.py:48-50; engine p1_factor_engine.py:1504): the ex-date falls inside month t and the declaration precedes it, so the dividend is public before month-t end; monthlyCRSP base rows at month t are month-end data.
factors.mechanism: All windows are trailing: 24-month rolling sum then shift(1) gives dividends over (t-24,t-1], initiation flag compares month-t dividend against that strictly-prior history, and the 6-month rolling max only propagates a PAST initiation forward (script asrol -> polars rolling_* trailing on a gap-filled sorted panel; engine _op_dividend_initiation_flag p1_factor_engine.py:2087-2098 uses pandas trailing rolling on a permno/time-sorted base). Engine spec param lookback_months:12 is ignored in favor of the hardcoded 24 — fidelity quirk, not a leak.

factors.input_timing: CRSP distributions divamt/distcd stamped at exdt month (ex-date is a public market event, preceded by declaration); factor at t uses trailing 3/6/12/18/24-month rolling sums and lags (asrol with calendar gap-fill in script DivOmit.py:64-242; pandas trailing rolling + backward shift in engine _op_dividend_omission_flag, p1_factor_engine.py:2101-2153) over months <= t; SignalMasterTable/monthlyCRSP base rows are month-t stamps of month-t data.
factors.mechanism: Both sides use only ex-date-stamped dividends through month t with trailing windows and backward shifts; no forward alignment anywhere.

factors.input_timing: Regular cash dividends (cd1==1,cd2==2) stamped at exdt month; frequency code cd3 forward-filled from past observations; prediction uses divpaid lags 2/5/8/11 months (DivSeason.py:136-169; engine _op_seasonal_dividend_indicator p1_factor_engine.py:2156-2179) — all strictly past months relative to t; 12-month trailing rolling sum gates eligibility.
factors.mechanism: Signal at t is built exclusively from dividend lags 2-11 months back and a trailing 12-month sum; cd3 ffill only propagates older info forward.

factors.input_timing: Dividends stamped at exdt month with lags 2/5/11 months for expected dividend (DivYieldST.py:94-102; engine p1_factor_engine.py:2192-2194); prc is CRSP month-t closing price (known end of month t); tercile assignment is a same-month cross-sectional qcut across stocks at t.
factors.mechanism: Expected dividend uses only past ex-dates; scaling by month-t price and same-month cross-sectional ranking are contemporaneous public data under the end-of-month-t convention. (Positional shift after the div12>0 row filter can reach further back than the nominal lag — a fidelity quirk that is backward-only.)

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP vol and prc stamped at their own month; script uses shift(2) so DolVol_t = log(vol_{t-2}*|prc_{t-2}|) (DolVol.py:30-34); engine tree instead computes a trailing 2-month rolling mean of |prc|*vol including month t with no log (_op_rolling_mean, p1_factor_engine.py:774-776) — month-t prc/vol are known at end of month t.
factors.mechanism: No future data on either side: script is lag-2, engine is a trailing window ending at t (pandas rolling is trailing on a contiguous monthly template index). Note: the engine definition diverges from the script (no 2-month lag, no log) — a fidelity bug, not look-ahead.

factors.input_timing: IBES recommendations stamped at anndats month (IBESRecommendations.py:62); month-t consensus = mean over analysts' last rec announced in month t; compared to previous rec-month consensus via backward groupby shift (DownRecomm.py:45-50; engine _op_recommendation_change_indicator p1_factor_engine.py:2065-2084); permno link via monthly IBES-CRSP validity-window table.
factors.mechanism: All recommendations used at t were announced during or before month t; the change indicator compares t to a prior month only. (Script's within-month 'last' per analyst is not sorted by anndats — engine sorts; nondeterminism within a month, not a timing leak.)

factors.input_timing: ceq/che/dltt/dlc/dc/tstkp/dvpa from m_aCompustat at t = fiscal-year data with datadate <= t-6 months (CompustatAnnual.py:212-215 confirms the 6-month reporting lag and 12-month forward carry keeping the freshest published record); mve_permco is month-t CRSP market equity, known at end of month t (script via SignalMasterTable, engine via monthlyCRSP panel).
factors.mechanism: Accounting inputs carry the 6-month publication lag; contemporaneous month-t market equity is public at month end. No December-ME or forward alignment involved.

factors.input_timing: ib from m_aCompustat at t (datadate <= t-6 months, 6-month lag verified); denominator is mve_permco lagged 6 calendar months (script self-merge on time_avail_m - 6 months, EP.py:50-56; engine lag(mve_permco,6) as panel shift on a contiguous month index, p1_factor_engine.py:704-710) — i.e., market equity near the fiscal-year-end month, strictly past.
factors.mechanism: Earnings are used only after the 6-month reporting lag and are scaled by 6-month-old market equity; both sides align t only with t-6.

factors.input_timing: epspxq from m_QCompustat at t available at max(datadate+3mo, rdq month) with >6-month-late filers dropped (CompustatQuarterly.py:83-113); surprise uses YoY change minus drift from lags 3-24 months and SD of lagged surprises — all backward (EarnSupBig.py:55-96 positional shifts; engine _op_seasonal_surprise_zscore calendar shifts, p1_factor_engine.py:1130-1154); mve_c and sicCRSP are month-t CRSP values used for a same-month cross-sectional size rank and industry mean of big firms' month-t surprises (relrank/industry_big_mean are within-month cross-sectional).
factors.mechanism: Quarterly EPS enters only after rdq/3-month lag; drift, SD, and lags are strictly backward; the industry aggregation averages other firms' already-available month-t signals cross-sectionally. (Script's positional shift(12) on the inner-merged panel can only reach further back when coverage gaps exist.)

factors.input_timing: epspx from m_aCompustat at t (datadate <= t-6 months); growth uses calendar lags 12/24 and consistency averages egrowth lags 0/12/24/36/48 (stata_multi_lag with gap-fill then backward shift, EarningsConsistency.py:46-62; engine _op_earnings_consistency panel lags, p1_factor_engine.py:1107-1127); exception filters use the same current-and-lagged values.
factors.mechanism: Every term is the month-t (already 6-month-lagged) EPS or a strictly older lag of it; no forward references.

factors.input_timing: meanest (fpi=1) and fgr5yr (fpi=0) from IBES_EPS_Unadj stamped at statpers month (mid-month summary date, known before month end); fy0a from IBES_UnadjustedActuals stamped at statpers month and forward-filled across gaps (stale-but-published prior-fiscal-year actual, IBESUnadjustedActuals.py:49-85); all merged contemporaneously at t (script EarningsForecastDisparity.py:45-78; engine p1_factor_engine.py:2341-2365).
factors.mechanism: All three inputs are IBES summary-file quantities computed as of statpers within month t; fy0a is the prior completed fiscal year's actual already recorded in the summary file, and forward-fill only propagates older values.

factors.input_timing: IBES_EPS_Adj fpi=6 rows: meanest/price as of statpers (consensus and price snapshot before the announcement), actual with anndats_act; both sides re-stamp time_avail_m to the anndats_act month and keep the latest pre-announcement statpers per ticker-announcement-month (EarningsStreak.py:34-59; engine _op_earnings_streak_signal p1_factor_engine.py:2475-2498); streak compares consecutive past announcements; signal forward-filled up to 6 months after announcement.
factors.mechanism: The surprise is stamped at the announcement month, not the forecast month — actual is public from anndats_act (within month t) and meanest/price predate it; streak lag and 6-month forward-fill only carry past announcements forward. This correctly avoids the classic leak of using IBES 'actual' at statpers month before announcement.

factors.input_timing: epspxq from m_QCompustat at t available at max(datadate+3mo, rdq month) (verified in CompustatQuarterly.py:83-113; rdq mid-month stamped at rdq month is usable at end of month t); YoY growth via calendar self-merge on t-12 (EarningsSurprise.py:45-49, lag lookup direction verified: row at t pulls the value stamped t-n); drift from growth lags 3-24 and SD from surprise lags 3-24, all backward (script calendar merges; engine _op_seasonal_surprise_zscore panel shifts).
factors.mechanism: Quarterly EPS enters only after its announcement-based availability stamp, and every drift/SD component is a strict calendar lag of already-available values; the t-12 self-merge aligns t with t-12, never t with t+k.

factors.input_timing: dltt/dlc/dc/che/oibdp/ceq from m_aCompustat: fiscal-year data public ~3-6mo after datadate, stamped and first used at datadate+6 (CompustatAnnual.py:212-215), held 12 months with dedup keeping the latest already-published datadate. mve_permco: CRSP end-of-month-t company market equity, public at end of month t, used at t (script merges SignalMasterTable on same time_avail_m; engine loads monthlyCRSP panel at t).
factors.mechanism: All inputs available by end of month t: accounting via the 6-month lag, market equity contemporaneous end-of-month; identical arithmetic in EntMult.py:38-43 and _op_enterprise_multiple (p1_factor_engine.py:820-822).

factors.input_timing: ceq/ib/sale/prcc_f/csho from a_aCompustat stamped datadate+6; prior-fiscal-year lags via groupby('gvkey').shift(1) use even older published data; monthly expansion adds offsets 0..+11 (availability only pushed later, never earlier); prcc_f*csho is the fiscal-year-end price used >=6 months after fiscal end.
factors.mechanism: Dedup traps checked and safe: gvkey-month dedup keeps latest datadate among rows already past their 6-month lag (all published by t); permno-month dedup prefers non-NA/earliest — same logic script (EquityDuration.py:104-136) and engine (_op_equity_duration_signal, p1_factor_engine.py:1642-1657). Only residual is the dataset-wide comp.funda restated-values vintage, common to every Compustat factor.

factors.input_timing: exchcd from crsp.msenames joined point-in-time (namedt<=date<=nameendt, CRSPMonthly.py:40-41): month-t code public during month t, used at t; script lags 1-12 and engine lag-12 are strictly backward.
factors.mechanism: Only current and past exchange codes enter. Non-timing drift: engine _op_exchange_switch_indicator (p1_factor_engine.py:769-771) flags ANY t vs t-12 difference (no direction filter, and NaN!=value evaluates True for newly-listed/missing months) vs the script's directional NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ logic over all 12 lags — a fidelity bug, not look-ahead.

factors.input_timing: int0a: IBES unadjusted actuals stamped at statpers month (IBESUnadjustedActuals.py:49-51), forward-fill only — public mid-month t, used at t. epspiq: m_QCompustat stamped max(datadate+3, rdq month) (CompustatQuarterly.py:83-113) — public by end of month t. Winsorization bounds: computed from ALL months pooled, i.e. partly from the future.
factors.mechanism: Both sides winsorize with full-sample quantiles: script computes q1/q99 over the entire 1976-present panel then clips every month (ExclExp.py:47-50); engine does the same (p1_factor_engine.py:2377-2381). The clip bounds applied to month t depend on the distribution of future months' ExclExp, so stamped values in the ~2% tails are functions of future data (also creates ties at the bounds that can move portfolio-boundary ranks). Core signal inputs are timing-clean; the leak is in the transformation. (Separate non-timing note: availability-month merge can pair int0a and epspiq from different fiscal quarters — noise, faithful to OSAP.)

factors.input_timing: meanest (fpi='1') from IBES summary stamped at statpers month (IBESEPSUnadjusted.py:47-49); statpers is mid-month (IBES summary calc date), so public before end of month t; used at t with no shift. Within-month dedup keeps latest statpers, still inside month t.
factors.mechanism: Forecast-issue-month stamping, no future rows can enter; engine _op_feps_signal (p1_factor_engine.py:2043-2047) filters fpi=='1' and merges the permno link at the same month, mirroring the script.

factors.input_timing: Only input is listing presence itself: script counts SignalMasterTable rows per permno through month t (cumcount); engine counts non-NaN prc months through t (cumsum of presence, p1_factor_engine.py:929-935). Presence at t is known at t; the 1926-cohort exclusion uses a deterministic calendar constant.
factors.mechanism: Pure backward cumulative count. Non-timing drift: engine anchors 'CRSP start' at the template index origin (monthlyCRSP min month) instead of the script's hard-coded 1926-07, and gaps in prc slow the engine's age counter — replication differences only.

factors.input_timing: ret lags 1-5 = months t-5..t-1 returns, public at their own month-ends (calendar-safe via fill_date_gaps/stata_multi_lag in the script, complete-calendar template shift in the engine); prc = end-of-month-t price for the $5 screen, public end of t; age = cumulative presence through t; quintile cut is cross-sectional within month t only.
factors.mechanism: All inputs available by end of month t; momentum window excludes month t itself. Engine (_op_firm_age_momentum, p1_factor_engine.py:966-971) matches timing; only drift is qcut vs percentile-rank bucketing and the script's pre-lag row filtering.

factors.input_timing: stdev and meanest from IBES summary stamped at statpers month (mid-month t), used at t, no shift; script filters fpi=='1' with valid fpedats.
factors.mechanism: Forecast-issue-month data only. Non-timing drift worth fixing: the engine tree uses raw var nodes on IBES_EPS_Unadj through DatasetStore.get (p1_factor_engine.py:416-431), which does NOT filter fpi — pivot aggfunc='last' over the fpi-sorted raw file makes fpi='6' (quarterly horizon) rows win where present, unlike the script's fpi='1'. All fpi rows share the same statpers-month availability, so this is a horizon-fidelity bug, not look-ahead.

factors.input_timing: m_aCompustat regressors (at/ceq/dltt/capx/sale/xrd/xad/ppent/ebitda): stamped datadate+6, public by t. mve_permco: end-of-month-t ME, public end of t. sicCRSP: point-in-time msenames industry at month t. Rolling regression at month t trains on window (t-59..t] only.
factors.mechanism: Training mask is time_avail <= current AND > current-60 on both sides (Frontier.py:159-162; p1_factor_engine.py:1757), so coefficients use the current and prior 59 months — contemporaneous-in-sample but never future months. Dependent variable log(ME) at t is end-of-month-t data, allowed at t. No future info path.

factors.input_timing: revt/cogs/at: stamped datadate+6, public by t — clean. sic: taken from m_aCompustat, which inherits it from comp.names — a HEADER table with one current-vintage SIC per gvkey (CompustatAnnual.py:147-156) applied uniformly to the firm's entire history; the classification 'as of download date' was not public at month t.
factors.mechanism: The non-financial screen (SIC<6000 or >=7000) at every historical month t uses the firm's present-day header SIC on both sides (script GP.py:37-40; engine nonfinancial_only on the same m_aCompustat 'sic', p1_factor_engine.py:803-806). A firm that later became (or stopped being) a financial reclassifies its whole past, retroactively changing universe membership. The GP ratio itself is timing-clean; the leak is confined to the screen. Historical sich is downloaded (CompustatAnnual.py:37) but unused — the natural fix. Faithful to OSAP's Stata original, but a genuine leak under the absolute standard.

factors.input_timing: xad at t: stamped datadate+6, public by t; lag-12 xad: prior fiscal year, public a year earlier; xad>=0.1 gate uses the same published value; size-decile filter uses end-of-month-t market equity (script mve_c, engine mve_permco), public end of t, cut cross-sectionally within t.
factors.mechanism: Log-growth of two already-published fiscal-year values plus month-t-only gates; engine delta/log/threshold_min/size_decile_filtered ops shift only backward on the complete monthly template. mve_c vs mve_permco is a share-class-aggregation drift, timing-identical.

factors.input_timing: rect/invt/ppent/aco/intan/ao/ap/lco/lo/at/dp at t: stamped datadate+6, public by t. Lag-12 values: the panel value that was already available at t-12 (published earlier still). dp is the current fiscal year's flow, same publication event as the levels.
factors.mechanism: Levels-minus-backward-lags arithmetic identical in script (GrLTNOA.py:83-129, permno-level shift(12) after dedup) and engine (_op_gr_ltnoa, p1_factor_engine.py:953-963, shift(12) on the complete monthly template); no self-join, no forward alignment, dedup keeps first occurrence (timing-neutral).

factors.input_timing: sale, invt from m_aCompustat: annual values stamped at time_avail_m = datadate+6mo (CompustatAnnual.py L212-214), forward-filled 12mo. Factor at t uses values stamped t, t-12, t-24 — all publicly reported >=6 months before t.
factors.mechanism: Script (GrSaleToGrInv.py L64-114) and engine (_op_growth_difference_fallback, p1_factor_engine.py L945-950) both compute current vs 12/24-month backward lags on the already-lagged m_aCompustat panel; engine shift is calendar-true on a complete MS index. Only caveat (library-wide, not factor-specific): comp.funda values are latest-vintage, not point-in-time vintages.

factors.input_timing: sale, xsga from m_aCompustat: stamped datadate+6mo. Factor at t uses stamps t, t-12, t-24.
factors.mechanism: Identical structure to GrSaleToGrInv: script GrSaleToGrOverhead.py L61-119 and engine _op_growth_difference_fallback use only backward calendar lags of 6-month-lagged accounting data.

factors.input_timing: sale from m_aCompustat (datadate+6mo, so each firm's cross-sectional value at t was public by t); sicCRSP/shrcd from CRSP msenames via date-range join (point-in-time as of month t); 36-month rolling mean uses months t-35..t.
factors.mechanism: Cross-sectional industry HHI at month t uses only data stamped <=t (script Herf.py L49-70 via asrol, which is polars trailing rolling_mean with calendar gap-fill; engine _op_rolling_industry_herfindahl L1079-1104 rolls trailing on the complete month index). Regulated-industry/year masks are deterministic rules, no future data.

factors.input_timing: at from m_aCompustat (datadate+6mo); sicCRSP/shrcd point-in-time at t; trailing 36-month mean t-35..t.
factors.mechanism: Same pipeline as Herf with 'at' as the metric (HerfAsset.py L49-69; engine rolling_industry_herfindahl). All inputs available by end of month t.

factors.input_timing: seq/ceq/pstk/pstkrv/pstkl/at/lt/txditc all from the same m_aCompustat row stamped datadate+6mo; sicCRSP/shrcd point-in-time at t; trailing 36-month mean.
factors.mechanism: Book equity is built purely from one contemporaneously-available annual row (HerfBE.py L62-84; engine tree coalesce/fillna over m_aCompustat vars feeding rolling_industry_herfindahl). No cross-period alignment beyond the trailing window.

factors.input_timing: dailyCRSP prc: daily prices through the last trading day of month t, stamped at time_avail_m = t (known at month-end t); 52-week high uses monthly maxes of months t-12..t-1.
factors.mechanism: Script (High52.py L34-65) divides end-of-month-t price by max over 12 positional monthly lags; engine _op_high_52 (L922-926) uses monthly_max.shift(1).rolling(12).max() on the union month index — both strictly backward. Positional lags in the script can span calendar gaps for stocks with non-trading months (stale, still past-only).

factors.input_timing: dailyCRSP ret and dailyFF mktrf/smb/hml/rf for days within month t; FF3 regression run within-month; stamped at time_avail_m = t (all inputs realized by month-end t; FF daily factors published with days of delay but well before the t+1 formation date).
factors.mechanism: Script ZZ0_RealizedVol_IdioVol3F_ReturnSkew3F.py L69-141 groups by permno-month and uses only that month's daily data — the within-month regression uses no data past month t. Engine side is not native: op 'idio_vol3_f' resolves to _op_delegate_to_script via SNAKE_TO_FACTOR (p1_factor_engine.py L2698-2701), running this same script and re-stamping yyyymm unchanged (standardize_factor_csv_to_parquet L640-664).

factors.input_timing: dailyCRSP ret, dailyFF mktrf/rf; 252-trading-day trailing CAPM regression ending at each day; the last available RMSE within month t is stamped at t.
factors.mechanism: Script ZZ2_IdioVolAHT.py L316-341: polars-ols rolling_ols windows end at the current row (trailing), then lastnm-per-month collapse keeps a value computed from days <= month-end t. Engine delegates to this script (SNAKE_TO_FACTOR -> _op_delegate_to_script). No forward window anywhere.

factors.input_timing: dailyCRSP ret/prc/vol within each month; monthly mean of |ret|/(|prc|*vol); 12-month average over months t-11..t stamped at t.
factors.mechanism: Script Illiquidity.py L44-82 averages current month plus 11 positional lags requiring all 12 present; engine tree monthly_mean -> rolling_mean(window=12, min_obs=12) (_op_rolling_mean L774-776) is the trailing equivalent on the union month index. All daily inputs realized by month-end t; window strictly backward-inclusive of t.

factors.input_timing: SignalMasterTable/monthlyCRSP ret for months t-1..t-5 (calendar-merged lags), mve_c and sicCRSP at month t (end-of-month-t cap, point-in-time SIC). All known by end of month t.
factors.mechanism: Script IndMom.py L44-96: Mom6m compounds only lagged returns via calendar DateOffset merges; cap-weighting within sic2-month uses month-t weights, contemporaneous with the stamp and available at formation (end of t). Engine _op_industry_weighted_momentum (L974-989) mirrors it with compound_return lags [1..5] and per-date cross-sectional weighting; fillna(0) on ret only widens the universe, no timing shift.

factors.input_timing: ret at month t (return realized during t, known at month-end t), mve_c at t for the size rank, sicCRSP at t mapped to FF48. Signal stamped at t, used for t+1 under the OSAP convention.
factors.mechanism: Script IndRetBig.py L43-78 and engine _op_industry_big_return (L2501-2522) are purely cross-sectional within each month t: rank by month-t cap, average month-t returns of top-30% firms. Month-t return as a stamp-t signal is contemporaneous, not future — it is public at the end-of-month-t formation date (Hou 2007 R(-1) convention).

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret for months t-7..t-12, obtained via calendar-exact merges (script) / calendar-true shifts on a complete MS index (engine).
factors.mechanism: Script IntMom.py L43-69 compounds only returns 7-12 months old; engine compound_return with lags [7..12] (_op_compound_return L725-736). Deep backward window, nothing contemporaneous or forward.

factors.input_timing: ceq (m_aCompustat, public at datadate+6mo, used at time_avail_m=t: OK); mve_permco (end-of-month-t market cap, used at t: OK); ret (month-t return known end of month t; cumret through t and 60-month backward lags: OK); per-month cross-sectional OLS uses only month-t data: OK.
factors.mechanism: Both sides. tempRet60/ret60 is trimmed at 1%/99% quantiles POOLED OVER THE ENTIRE SAMPLE, so the trim threshold at month t depends on future months' 60-month returns. Script: ZZ1_IntanBM_IntanSP_IntanCFP_IntanEP.py:96 winsor2(..., by=None) -> utils/winsor2.py:217-237 (quantile over full panel). Engine: p1_factor_engine.py:1542 _op_intangible_residual calls _trim_global (lines 1210-1219, np.nanquantile over the whole month x permno panel). tempRet60 is both the regression y and part of the vRet regressor, so future data changes which obs enter the month-t cross-sectional regression and its fitted betas, i.e. the stamped residual. Second-order in magnitude (inherited from the OSAP Stata original) but a genuine full-sample statistic used in-sample.

factors.input_timing: ib, dp (m_aCompustat, public at datadate+6mo, used at t: OK); mve_permco (end-of-month-t, used at t: OK); ret (through month t plus backward 60-month lags: OK); month-t cross-sectional OLS: OK.
factors.mechanism: Same shared mechanism as IntanBM: full-sample 1%/99% trim of tempRet60/ret60 on both sides (script ZZ1 line 96 via winsor2 with by=None; engine _op_intangible_residual p1_factor_engine.py:1542 -> _trim_global lines 1210-1219). Trim cutoffs at month t are computed from all months including the future, altering the month-t regression sample/inputs and hence the residual factor value.

factors.input_timing: ni (m_aCompustat, public at datadate+6mo, used at t: OK); mve_permco (end-of-month-t, used at t: OK); ret (through month t, backward lags only: OK); month-t cross-sectional OLS: OK.
factors.mechanism: Same shared mechanism: pooled full-sample 1%/99% trim of the 60-month return on both script (ZZ1 line 96, winsor2 by=None) and engine (_op_intangible_residual line 1542 -> _trim_global lines 1210-1219). Future months' return realizations move the trim thresholds applied at month t.

factors.input_timing: sale (m_aCompustat, public at datadate+6mo, used at t: OK); mve_permco (end-of-month-t, used at t: OK); ret (through month t, backward lags only: OK); month-t cross-sectional OLS: OK.
factors.mechanism: Same shared mechanism: pooled full-sample 1%/99% trim of tempRet60/ret60 on both sides (script winsor2 by=None at ZZ1 line 96; engine _trim_global via _op_intangible_residual lines 1541-1542). Month-t trim cutoffs embed future-sample information.

factors.input_timing: ppegt, invt, at (m_aCompustat, public at datadate+6mo, stamped at time_avail_m; row for month t reflects the latest fiscal year available by t). Signal at t uses values at t and 12-month lags (script InvestPPEInv.py:68-70 positional shift(12); engine delta/lag with calendar shift(12) on the monthly template).
factors.mechanism: Only backward lags of availability-lagged annual data on both sides; the download's 12x monthly expansion is forward-only with dedup keeping the latest already-published datadate (CompustatAnnual.py:224-244). No future info enters.

factors.input_timing: capx, revt (m_aCompustat, public at datadate+6mo, used at t). Ratio at t normalized by a trailing 36-month rolling mean (min 24 obs) ending at t: script utils/asrol.py uses polars rolling_mean (trailing, includes current row); engine _op_investment_to_sales_scaled (p1_factor_engine.py:850-854) uses pandas .rolling(36) (trailing). revt>=10 filter uses current revt only.
factors.mechanism: Trailing-window normalization plus contemporaneous filter over availability-lagged data; no centered/forward windows and no full-sample statistics on either side.

factors.input_timing: ret (monthlyCRSP/SignalMasterTable, month-t return known end of month t). Script compounds lags 13-36 via positional shift per permno (LRreversal.py:34-45); engine compound_return with calendar lags 13-60 via panel shift (p1_factor_engine.py:725-736), lag k>=13 strictly in the past.
factors.mechanism: All inputs are strictly positive (backward) lags of realized monthly returns on both sides; pandas/positional shifts can only reach further into the past when gaps exist. Note (not look-ahead): engine window is t-13..t-60 vs script t-13..t-36 — a spec-fidelity divergence using only past data.

factors.input_timing: lt (m_aCompustat, public at datadate+6mo, used at t); mve_permco (SignalMasterTable/monthlyCRSP, end-of-month-t market cap = shrout*|prc| summed by permco within month t, used at t — available by end of month t as the convention allows).
factors.mechanism: Simple contemporaneous ratio of availability-lagged book liabilities to end-of-month-t market equity on both sides; no lags, joins, or statistics that touch future months.

factors.input_timing: ret (monthlyCRSP/SignalMasterTable, month-t return known end of month t). Script compounds calendar lags 13-18 via merge on time_avail_m - k months (MRreversal.py:38-72); engine compound_return with calendar lags 1-24 via panel shift, all k>=1 in the past.
factors.mechanism: Only positive calendar lags of realized returns on both sides — no future months referenced. Note (not look-ahead): engine compounds t-1..t-24 vs script t-13..t-18, a large definitional divergence (engine includes the recent year the script deliberately skips) but still past-only data.

factors.input_timing: Annual items (at, ceq, ni, oancf, fopt, wcapch, ib, dp, xrd, capx, xad, revt): public at datadate+6mo, used at t. Quarterly items (niq, atq, saleq, oancfy, capxy, xrdq, fqtr): stamped at max(datadate+3mo, rdq month) with forward-only 3-month expansion (CompustatQuarterly.py:90-100,173-201); rdq-month stamping is fine because formation is at END of month t while announcement occurs during month t. mve_permco/sicCRSP: end-of-month-t. BM quintiles and industry medians computed within month t only; rolling sums/vols are trailing (positional or gap-filled trailing windows, both sides); ytd-to-quarterly diffs use prior quarters; tempMS refresh-month gating plus forward-fill propagates only past values.
factors.mechanism: Every derived quantity is contemporaneous-or-backward relative to availability stamps on both script (MS.py) and engine (_op_ms_signal, p1_factor_engine.py:1873-2008). Residual notes, neither look-ahead: rows with missing rdq rely on the 3-month reporting-lag assumption; the script's refresh formula (datadate.month+6)%12 maps June fiscal-year-ends to 0 and silently drops them (engine's ((m-1+6)%12)+1 is correct) — a coverage bug, not future info.

factors.input_timing: Daily CRSP returns of month t (each known on its trade date, all known by end of month t); factor stamped at time_avail_m = t and used for formation at end of month t. Script groups by permno-month (MaxRet.py:27-30); engine _op_monthly_max groups the daily panel by calendar month (p1_factor_engine.py:911-912).
factors.mechanism: Max of within-month-t realized daily returns stamped at t — fully observable by the end-of-month-t formation point on both sides; no cross-month or future references.

factors.input_timing: revt (m_aCompustat, public at datadate+6mo, used at t). Growth at t = log(revt_t) - log(revt_{t-12}) via calendar merge (script) / calendar shift (engine); cross-sectional rank computed within each month using only that month's growth values; final signal at t uses ranks at t-12, t-24, t-36, t-48, t-60 via backward calendar merges (script MeanRankRevGrowth.py:73-114) / backward shifts (engine _op_weighted_lagged_rank_growth, p1_factor_engine.py:992-1003).
factors.mechanism: Within-month ranking plus strictly backward calendar lags of those ranks on both sides; no future months enter any rank or weight.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return stamped time_avail_m=m (CRSPMonthly.py mofd(date)), public at end of month m. Factor at t uses ret of months t-11..t-1, all public before end of t.
factors.mechanism: Script compounds stata_multi_lag lags 1-11 (calendar-gap-filled backward shift); engine compound_return lags 1-11 via shift(k) on a complete ascending monthly grid — both strictly backward.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return public at end of month m. Factor at t averages ret of months t-10..t-1 (annual lag 11 excluded by construction never triggers in range 1-10).
factors.mechanism: Script mean of backward lags 1-10 after fill_date_gaps; engine mean_of_lags [1..10] with backward shift. fill_missing=0 vs script NaN-skip mean diverges numerically at series start but only zero-fills, no future data.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return public at end of month m. Factor at t uses ret of months t-5..t-1.
factors.mechanism: Script compounds lags 1-5 via stata_multi_lag; engine compound_return lags 1-5; both strictly backward calendar lags.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return public at end of month m. Factor at t averages ret of months t-58..t-12 excluding annual lags 23/35/47/59.
factors.mechanism: Script lags range(12,60) minus (lag+1)%12==0; engine lag list is the identical 44 lags [12-22,24-34,36-46,48-58]; backward shift on both sides.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return public at end of month m. Factor at t averages ret of months t-118..t-60 excluding annual lags 71/83/95/107/119.
factors.mechanism: Script lags range(60,120) minus annual; engine identical 55-lag list; strictly backward shifts on gap-filled/complete monthly grids.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return public at end of month m. Factor at t averages ret of months t-178..t-120 excluding annual lags 131/143/155/167/179.
factors.mechanism: Script lags range(120,180) minus annual; engine identical 55-lag list; backward-only shifts.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return public at end of month m. Factor at t averages ret of months t-238..t-180 excluding annual lags 191/203/215/227/239.
factors.mechanism: Script lags range(180,240) minus annual; engine identical 55-lag list; backward-only shifts.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return public at end of month m. Factor at t uses ret of t-5..t-1 (Mom6m) and t-36..t-13 (Mom36m); quintile breakpoints use only the month-t cross-section of those backward-looking values.
factors.mechanism: Script: backward lags then within-month qcut per time_avail_m; engine momentum_reversal_signal: compound_return lags 1-5 / 13-36 then _row_bucket rank(axis=1) per month row — no pooling across time, no forward alignment. (Engine fillna(0) on the full ret panel lets pre-listing permnos enter the month-t ranking with zero momentum — a fidelity divergence from the script, not a leak.)

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return public at end of month m. Factor at t averages ret at lags 23/35/47/59 months (same-calendar-month returns of years 2-5 relative to predicted month t+1).
factors.mechanism: Script rowmean of stata_multi_lag lags [23,35,47,59]; engine mean_of_lags same list; both strictly backward. Engine fill_missing=0 divides by all 4 lags at series edges vs script NaN-skip — numeric divergence only, zero-fill carries no future info.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return public at end of month m. Factor at t averages ret at lags 71/83/95/107/119 months.
factors.mechanism: Identical backward-lag construction on both sides with matching lag lists; edge-case zero-fill divergence in engine mean is backward-looking.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return public at end of month m. Factor at t averages ret at lags 131/143/155/167/179 months.
factors.mechanism: Identical backward-lag construction on both sides with matching lag lists; shift(k>0) on ascending complete monthly index cannot reach future rows.

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret: month-m return public at end of month m. Factor at t averages ret at lags 191/203/215/227/239 months.
factors.mechanism: Identical backward-lag construction on both sides with matching lag lists; strictly backward shifts, no self-join or restatement channel (CRSP ret is not restated; delisting return is announced within its stamped month).

factors.input_timing: ret (monthlyCRSP via SignalMasterTable): return realized during month t-11 (script) / t-11 and t-23 (engine), publicly available at end of those past months; factor stamped at t.
factors.mechanism: Script (MomSeasonShort.py:42) uses stata_multi_lag lag 11 (gap-filled positive shift = backward calendar lag); engine uses mean_of_lags [11,23] via _op_lag shift on a contiguous monthly index (p1_factor_engine.py:717-722, 704-710) — all inputs strictly in the past. Side note (not look-ahead): engine's [11,23] mean and fill_missing=0 differ from script's single lag-11 definition.

factors.input_timing: ret: months t-1..t-5 (past). vol: trailing 6-month mean over t-5..t incl. current month — month-t volume is known at end of month t, which is exactly the stamp month. Momentum deciles / volume terciles: cross-section of the same month t.
factors.mechanism: Script lags via stata_multi_lag (backward), asrol is a trailing polars rolling_mean over a gap-filled sorted panel (asrol.py:76-97), qcut buckets are groupby(time_avail_m) per-month; engine _op_momentum_volume_signal (p1_factor_engine.py:1034-1042) mirrors this with compound_return over lags 1-5, vol.rolling(6) trailing, and _row_bucket per-month rank; the 24-obs gate uses only history. Nothing reaches past end of month t.

factors.input_timing: at, che, dltt, mib, dc, ceq from m_aCompustat at t: fiscal data with datadate >= 6 months before t (CompustatAnnual.py:212-215), i.e. assumed published by t. l12.at: same data 12 months earlier.
factors.mechanism: Script shift(12) is a positional backward shift within permno sorted ascending (NOA.py:47,56) — can only reach older rows even across gaps; engine uses calendar lag(at,12) backward. All numerator fields taken at their availability-stamped month; nothing forward.

factors.input_timing: dltis, dltr, dlcch, at from m_aCompustat at t (datadate+6 availability lag embedded); l12.at from t-12.
factors.mechanism: Both sides use only month-t availability-lagged annual data and a backward 12-month lag of at (script NetDebtFinance.py:45, engine lag op); dedup keep-first operates on an already unique permno-month file. Side note (not look-ahead): engine expression is dltis - dltr - fillna(dlcch,0), flipping the script's +dlcch sign.

factors.input_timing: Script: dltt, dlc, pstk, dvpa, tstkp, che, sic, at, ib, csho, ceq, prcc_f from m_aCompustat at t (>=6-month reporting lag); mve_permco from monthlyCRSP at t = end-of-month-t market cap, available end of month t (CRSPMonthly.py:73) — permitted at stamp t. Engine: 12-month change in (dltt+dlc-che) plus lag(mve_permco,6), all t or earlier.
factors.mechanism: Script's BM quintile filter uses fastxtile_by_group grouped by time_avail_m (same-month cross-section only); engine nonfinancial_only masks on sic at t and lags are backward shifts. No December-ME-before-December or future-price usage. Side note (not look-ahead): engine implements a net-debt change over lagged ME rather than the script's net-debt level (incl. pstk+dvpa-tstkp) over current ME.

factors.input_timing: sstk, prstkc, dv, at from m_aCompustat at t (datadate+6 embedded); l12.at from t-12.
factors.mechanism: Identical backward structure to NetDebtFinance on both sides (script shift(12) positional backward, engine calendar lag). Side note (not look-ahead): engine omits the -dv term present in the script.

factors.input_timing: dvc, prstkc, sstk, sic, ceq from m_aCompustat at t (>=6-month lag from datadate); mve_permco lagged 6 months (t-6), available long before t.
factors.mechanism: Script's calendar lag is a self-merge where the lookup row's time_avail_m equals t-6 (NetPayoutYield.py:47-56) — strictly backward, no t/t+k alignment; the 24-obs cumcount gate uses only prior rows; engine uses lag(mve_permco,6) shift. Clean on both sides.

factors.input_timing: ibq from m_QCompustat at t: time_avail_m = max(datadate+3 months, rdq month), filings >6 months late dropped (CompustatQuarterly.py:90-113); an rdq-month stamp means the announcement occurs during month t, so data is available by end of month t as the convention requires. Lags of chearn at t-3..t-24 are older still.
factors.mechanism: Script builds chearn and its lags via calendar self-merges on time_avail_m - k (NumEarnIncrease.py:38-51) — each merge matches row t to the row stamped exactly k months earlier; engine _op_earnings_increase_streak (p1_factor_engine.py:1157-1168) uses only lag(chearn, 0..24) backward shifts. Residual data caveat, not a coded leak: rows with missing rdq fall back to the unverified datadate+3 assumption (mostly pre-1971). Side note (not look-ahead): engine emits 0 rather than missing outside the ibq-covered universe.

factors.input_timing: xsga, cogs, at from m_aCompustat at t — annual fundamentals with the 6-month reporting lag embedded at build time.
factors.mechanism: Pure contemporaneous ratio of availability-lagged fields on both sides (script OPLeverage.py:41-53, engine div/add/fillna); no lags, no cross-time joins, nothing to leak.

factors.input_timing: revt, cogs, xsga, xint, ceq from m_aCompustat at t (datadate+6); size ranks from mve_c (script) / mve_permco (engine) at t = end-of-month-t market cap, available end of month t.
factors.mechanism: Size terciles are computed within each month's cross-section — script groupby(time_avail_m) qcut (OperProf.py:51-53), engine _op_size_filtered rank(axis=1) per month row (p1_factor_engine.py:825-841) — so no pooled full-sample breakpoints and no future months in the ranking. Side note (not look-ahead): engine ranks on mve_permco where the script uses mve_c.

factors.input_timing: xrd, revt, cogs, xsga, at, ceq from m_aCompustat at t (6-month lag embedded); filter fields shrcd, sicCRSP, mve_c from monthlyCRSP at t (end-of-month-t values).
factors.mechanism: Contemporaneous ratio of availability-lagged accounting data with same-month static filters on both sides (script OperProfRD.py:52-61, engine div/add/fillna); merge is on (permno, time_avail_m) with no time offset.

factors.input_timing: ob, at from m_aCompustat at t (datadate+6); l12.at from t-12.
factors.mechanism: Script shift(12) positional backward within sorted permno panel (OrderBacklog.py:33), engine calendar lag(at,12) backward, plus a zero-to-null mask on the same-month ob value — no forward-looking input on either side.

factors.input_timing: ob, at from m_aCompustat: fiscal-year values stamped datadate+6mo and carried 12mo forward (CompustatAnnual.py:212-244). Factor at t uses the t row plus 12-month-lagged rows only.
factors.mechanism: Both sides use only backward lags: script (OrderBacklogChg.py:30,37) groupby.shift(12) after sort; engine tree delta/lag(12) on calendar-indexed monthly panels (p1_factor_engine.py:704-714). Script shift is positional (no gap fill) so on gappy panels it can grab data older than 12 months — staler, never future.

factors.input_timing: Nine Compustat fields at t (datadate+6mo lag embedded) and their 12-month lags; mve_permco and shrout from monthlyCRSP at t = end-of-month-t values (standard end-of-month formation); BM quintile computed cross-sectionally within month t.
factors.mechanism: Script (PS.py:82-87) lags via fill_date_gaps + stata_multi_lag = true backward calendar lags; engine _op_piotroski_score (p1_factor_engine.py:2530-2581) uses shift(12) on the calendar monthly template and row-wise BM buckets per month. No future rows enter either side.

factors.input_timing: dvc/prstkc/pstkrv at t (datadate+6mo); denominator is market equity 6 months BEFORE t (≈ fiscal-year-end ME, itself end-of-month data from monthlyCRSP).
factors.mechanism: Script (PayoutYield.py:55-64) merges mve_permco via calendar lag6_date lookup; engine uses lag(mve_permco,6) on the monthly panel — both strictly backward. Engine drops the script's 24-obs/SIC/ceq filters (fidelity, not timing).

factors.input_timing: ib, oancf, dp and balance-sheet items all from the same m_aCompustat row at t (datadate+6mo); fallback uses 12-month backward lags of act/che/lct/dlc/txp.
factors.mechanism: Script (PctAcc.py:53-57) uses backward positional shift(12); engine _op_cash_flow_from_operations_fallback (p1_factor_engine.py:755-759) uses backward calendar lags. No future data. Note: engine fallback omits the txp change term the script includes — a fidelity gap, not look-ahead.

factors.input_timing: ni, prstkcc, sstk, dvt, oancf, fincf, ivncf all contemporaneous from the single m_aCompustat row at t (datadate+6mo publication lag embedded).
factors.mechanism: Pure same-row arithmetic on one annual report per month on both sides (PctTotAcc.py:43-46; engine sub/add/div tree) — no lags, joins, or cross-time operations at all.

factors.input_timing: feps1/feps2: May statpers consensus stamped June (statpers month +1mo, ZZ1 script:57-59 / engine:1351-1356); LTG: June statpers (mid-June, public by June-end stamp); ROE/SG/BM from m_aCompustat at June t (datadate+6mo, datadate month>=6 screen); mve = end-of-June shrout*|prc|. FErr at t = FROE1 from June t-12 minus ROE published >=6mo before t. Rank regressors lagged one June back.
factors.mechanism: Cross-sectional FErr regression is fit strictly within each June t group (.over(time_avail_m) in script; _ols_predictions_by_group in engine p1_factor_engine.py:1302-1330) using realized ROE already public at t and year-old forecasts; coefficients applied to same-t ranks; 12-month forward expansion only propagates past values. Engine lags ranks by positional shift(1) over June rows (vs script's calendar 12mo join) — can only reach further into the past.

factors.input_timing: prc from monthlyCRSP/SignalMasterTable at t = closing price of month t, known at month-end formation.
factors.mechanism: log|prc| of the contemporaneous month with no transformation across time on either side (Price.py:28; engine log(abs(prc)) tree) — end-of-month-t price for a t-stamped signal is the library-wide formation convention.

factors.input_timing: Daily returns (dailyCRSP, stamped trading day) and FF market factors (dailyFF, same-day) from July y-1 through June y; result stamped July y (June group +1 skip-month, script:301-303) and forward-filled up to the next annual estimate.
factors.mechanism: Engine delegates to the same ZZ2 script (daily deps fail _can_execute_natively, p1_factor_engine.py:261-269). Regression window ends June 30 of year y, stamp is July y — data predates the stamp by a month; mktLag1-4 are backward shifts; forward-fill only propagates old estimates. No future returns enter any group.

factors.input_timing: Same as PriceDelayRsq: trailing 12-month daily window ending June y, unrestricted-regression slopes, stamped July y then forward-filled.
factors.mechanism: Identical script path (ZZ2:97-303); group assignment maps each daily obs to the NEXT June (month+6mo year extraction) so windows are strictly trailing, and the +1 month offset adds a conservative skip-month. Engine side is the same script via delegation.

factors.input_timing: Same trailing July y-1..June y daily window; t-statistics of market-lag coefficients; stamped July y, forward-filled.
factors.mechanism: Same construction as the other two PriceDelay measures in the shared script; all regressors are contemporaneous or lagged market returns within a window that closes before the stamp month begins. Engine delegates to the script.

factors.input_timing: xrd from m_aCompustat at t (datadate+6mo publication lag); mve_permco from monthlyCRSP at t (end-of-month-t market equity).
factors.mechanism: Same-month join of a 6-months-stale accounting number to current market equity on both sides (RD.py:36-39; engine div tree) — current-month ME in the denominator is available at formation; no future data.

factors.input_timing: xrd, sale from a_aCompustat by fyear; the gamma at fiscal year i comes from a TRAILING 8-year window (rows i-7..i) of sales growth regressed on R&D intensity lagged 1-5 more years; stamped datadate_i+6mo, expanded 12 months forward, dedup keeps latest available datadate <= t; R&D-intensity terciles cut within each annual stamp month.
factors.mechanism: Script rolling_ols window_size=8 over gvkey sorted by fyear (RDAbility.py:282-291) and engine window start=max(0,i-7)..i (p1_factor_engine.py:1817-1826) are both trailing-inclusive; tempXLag is a backward shift; tercile qcut is cross-sectional within one stamp month; expansion/dedup only carries past reports forward. No path touches fyear > i.

factors.input_timing: xrd, at from m_aCompustat: annual data at time_avail_m carries a verified 6-month post-datadate lag (CompustatAnnual.py L212-215), so values used at t were filed >=6 months before t; xrd lags 12/24/36/48 reach further back. mve_c (script: SignalMasterTable; engine: monthlyCRSP) is end-of-month-t market cap, public at end of t; size terciles are cross-sectional within month t only.
factors.mechanism: Both sides use only t-and-earlier data: script lags via stata_multi_lag (fill_date_gaps + backward shift, RDcap.py L51-66); engine lags via shift on a contiguous monthly grid (_op_lag, p1_factor_engine.py L704-710) with same-month cross-sectional size rank. Side note (not lookahead): engine output is provably all-NaN because _op_size_filtered's default min_tercile=2 contradicts the spec's max_tercile=1 (engine L825-841, confirmed 'engine_broken_empty' in p1_factor_reconciliation.json), and the engine's grid-wide fillna(0) manufactures early-window values from backward-looking zeros.

factors.input_timing: meanest from IBES_EPS_Unadj stamped at statpers month (forecast-issue month, IBESEPSUnadjusted.py L48) — the consensus used at t was computed mid-month t, public by end of t; revisions sum current + 6 backward lags (months t-6..t). prc scaling uses the previous row's price (t-1 or older). Fill-forward of meanest uses only shift(1) lagged values.
factors.mechanism: All shifts are backward on both sides: script REV6.py L74-91 (positional shift(1) and shift(1..6) per permno); engine _op_sum_scaled_revisions L2296-2328 mirrors it on IBES-link rows with monthlyCRSP prc. The known discrepancy (positional shift jumping SMT gaps, reconciliation-confirmed) pulls *older* stale data, never future data.

factors.input_timing: dailyCRSP ret and dailyFF rf for trading days inside month t, stamped time_avail_m = t (ZZ0 script L69); daily market data is public same-day, so the full month's returns are known at end of t.
factors.mechanism: Std of within-month-t daily excess returns only — no cross-month window, no future days; engine is script-backed (FactorScriptAdapter runs the identical OSAP script; _can_execute_natively=False for daily deps), and the CSV-to-parquet standardization does not shift dates (engine L640-664).

factors.input_timing: monthlyCRSP ret and monthlyFF rf/mktrf/smb/hml stamped at their own return month (FamaFrenchMonthly.py L43); the FF3 rolling regression at observation s uses the trailing 36-obs window ending at s; the momentum score at t averages residuals from observations t-11..t-1 (shift(1) then 11-obs rolling mean).
factors.mechanism: Script-backed on both sides (rolling_residual_momentum is a delegated operator); rolling_ols windows end at the current row and residuals are lagged one observation before scoring (ZZ1 script L85-146), so every input to the t-stamped value is from month t-1 or earlier; position-based windows can only substitute *older* data when a permno has gaps.

factors.input_timing: dailyCRSP ret for days inside month t, grouped by time_avail_m = truncate(time_d,month) (ReturnSkew.py L48), public same-day; >=15-day filter uses only the same month's row count.
factors.mechanism: Pure within-month-t aggregation (skewness) with no lags or leads; engine is script-backed with date-preserving standardization.

factors.input_timing: dailyCRSP ret and dailyFF mktrf/smb/hml/rf for days inside month t; the FF3 regression is estimated per permno-month on that month's days only, and the skewness of its residuals is stamped at t.
factors.mechanism: The within-month regression uses no data outside month t (ZZ0 script L84-141), so betas and residuals at t depend only on month-t public market data; engine is script-backed (daily deps force script execution).
